Operations proceeded normally during the production run of Feastables Cookies & Cream. Quality department checks revealed no deviations affecting the product. However, it was noted that the information printed on the bars—specifically the "Best By" date and the code—occasionally presented legibility issues (TG3). Additionally, on some final retail displays, the "Best By" date was incomplete. To address the former, staff remain vigilant and perform frequent cleaning in the printing area to ensure that the data is clear and legible; regarding the latter, the caddies are being re-checked and replaced as necessary.
